Sasha Levin, a distinguished engineer at Nvidia and co-maintainer of the Linux kernel, has proposed a kill switch mechanism that would allow Linux server admins to disable vulnerable kernel functions until patches are available. While Red Hat expressed support for the capability, security experts and forum users expressed concerns about the approach, with some calling it a 'terrible idea' and others warning it could delay actual patching efforts.
